# YM06: 碧桐书院 Bitong Shuyuan, "Library of the Green Wu T'ung Trees"

Wave 2 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM06` · Page: `/scenes/#YM06` · Row: `research/buildings/YM06-bitong-shuyuan/`

## What it was

碧桐书院 Bitong Shuyuan, "Library of the Green Paulownias", lay north of 五福堂 across the stream, enclosed by hills: a front hall of three bays, a main hall of five, and a rear hall 后照殿 of five, with 云岑亭 Yuncen Ting on rocks to the west (S05 j80:34b). The plaque is by Yongzheng, so it existed before 1735 (S05 j80:35a). Burned October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **built** by 1744 (first dated item); **changed** Differs on later plans (S41). Malone p.79: official map patch shows rebuilt layout on this island.; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S02, S08, S41, S01, S360).

## The scene itself

### The leaf of 1744, its poem and preface

Preface of 1744: "前接平橋環以帶水庭左右修梧數本緑隂張蓋" (S05 j80:35a): a flat bridge in front, a belt of water round it, tall paulownias left and right of the court spreading shade; the emperor liked the sound of rain on their leaves.

## Interior and setting

### Interior

Malone was told by a palace painter that the Tongzhi Emperor was born in 慎德堂 on the 九洲清晏 island; another tradition, 'Yuan's memorandum', says in 'Pi T'ao Shu Yuan', which Malone takes to mean 碧桐书院 (S02 p.79 n.). He also says four paulownias (wu t'ung) stood in its courts (S02 p.79).

### The garden around it

A closed court of three halls on one axis (3, 5, 5 bays), water round it and a flat bridge at the front, hills round the north, paulownias in the court, a rock with a pavilion on the west (S05 j80:34b-35a).

| Row | Kind | What | Source | Quote or basis | Grade | Seen |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YM06 | water | A thin waterfall drops from the wooded hill west of the compound into the hollow | S08 P0006, combo ym06 cell 13 | my reading | A | viewed |
